```yaml
name: Docs Preview Build

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - develop
      - feature/*
      - bugfix/*

jobs:
  build-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Build docs
        run: npm run docs:build

      - name: Upload docs artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: docs-build
          path: docs/build

name: Docs Preview Deploy

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["Docs Preview Build"]
    types: [completed]

jobs:
  deploy-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' && github.repository == 'NVIDIA/NemoClaw'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Download docs artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: docs-build

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Deploy docs
        run: npm run docs:deploy
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Cleanup gh-pages
        run: |
          git checkout gh-pages
          git rm -rf *
          cp -r docs/build/* .
          git add .
          git commit -m "Update docs"
          git push origin gh-pages --force
```
